mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_graph_history (tenant_id, workflow_id, xml, node_count, edge_count) SELECT #{param1}, w.id, w.graph->>'xml', (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task'), (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_edge e WHERE e.workflow_id = w.id) FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1} AND w.id = #{param2} AND w.graph->>'xml' IS NOT NULL
INSERT INTO workflow_edge (tenant_id, workflow_id, from_key, to_key, edge_type) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, 'sequence') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow SET graph = jsonb_set(COALESCE(graph, '{}'::jsonb), '{xml}', to_jsonb(#{param3}::text)), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", name AS "name", category AS "category", island_id AS "islandId" FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", name AS "name", category AS "category" FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id
SELECT workflow_id AS "workflowId", from_key AS "fromKey", to_key AS "toKey" FROM workflow_edge
SELECT id AS "id", code AS "code", graph->>'xml' AS "xml" FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND graph->>'xml' IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_node (tenant_id, workflow_id, node_key, name, node_type, capability_id, params, estimate_sec, resource_id, seq) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workflowId}, #{nodeKey}, #{name}, #{nodeType}, #{capabilityId}, #{insertParams}::jsonb, 0, #{resourceId}, #{seq}) ON CONFLICT (workflow_id, node_key) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, node_type = EXCLUDED.node_type, params = COALESCE(workflow_node.params, '{}'::jsonb) || #{updateParams}::jsonb, resource_id = EXCLUDED.resource_id, seq = EXCLUDED.seq, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS "id", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.name AS "name", n.node_type AS "nodeType", n.estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", c.code AS "capability", n.params->>'protocol_name' AS "protocolName", (n.params->>'equipment_instance_id')::bigint AS "equipmentInstanceId" FROM workflow_node n LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = n.capability_id WHERE n.workflow_id = #{param1} ORDER BY n.id

SELECT n.workflow_id AS "workflowId", n.id AS "id", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.name AS "name", n.node_type AS "nodeType", n.estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", cap.code AS "capability", n.params->>'protocol_name' AS "protocolName", (n.params->>'equipment_instance_id')::bigint AS "equipmentInstanceId" FROM workflow_node n LEFT JOIN capability cap ON cap.id = n.capability_id
SELECT c.code AS "code", array_agg(rc.resource_id ORDER BY rc.resource_id) AS "ids" FROM resource_capability rc JOIN capability c ON c.id = rc.capability_id GROUP BY c.code
SELECT DISTINCT dm.method AS "method", c.code AS "capabilityCode" FROM device_method dm JOIN capability c ON c.id = dm.capability_id ORDER BY dm.method, c.code

SELECT rc.resource_id AS "id", c.code AS "capabilityCode" FROM resource_capability rc JOIN capability c ON c.id = rc.capability_id UNION SELECT di.id AS "id", c.code AS "capabilityCode" FROM device_instance di JOIN resource_capability rc ON rc.resource_id = di.resource_id JOIN capability c ON c.id = rc.capability_id WHERE di.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT n.workflow_id AS "workflowId", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", c.code AS "capabilityCode" FROM workflow_node n JOIN capability c ON c.id = n.capability_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.node_type = 'task'
INSERT INTO workflow (tenant_id, code, name, category, island_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, 'choreography', #{islandId}) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO workflow_node (tenant_id, workflow_id, node_key, name, node_type, capability_id, params) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workflowId}, #{nodeKey}, #{name}, #{nodeType}, (SELECT id FROM capability WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND code = #{capabilityCode}), #{paramsJson}::jsonb) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_edge (tenant_id, workflow_id, from_key, to_key, edge_type, condition) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workflowId}, #{fromKey}, #{toKey}, 'sequence', '{}'::jsonb)
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow SET graph = jsonb_build_object('format','bpmn2','xml',#{xml}) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{workflowId}
mapper.select: SELECT cap.code FROM device_instance di JOIN device d ON d.id = di.device_id JOIN capability cap ON cap.id = d.capability_id WHERE di.resource_id = #{resourceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS "id", graph->>'xml' AS "xml" FROM workflow WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", node_type AS "nodeType", name AS "name", capability_id AS "capabilityId", estimate_sec AS "estimateSec", params::text AS "params" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} ORDER BY id
SELECT from_key AS "fromKey", to_key AS "toKey" FROM workflow_edge WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} ORDER BY id

SELECT n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.name AS "name", c.code AS "capability", COALESCE(n.params->>'protocol_name', c.code) AS "method", (n.params->>'bound_resource_id')::bigint AS "bound" FROM workflow_node n LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = n.capability_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.workflow_id = #{param2} AND n.node_type = 'task' ORDER BY n.id

SELECT n.id AS "id", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", n.name AS "name", c.code AS "capability", COALESCE(n.params->>'protocol_name', c.code) AS "method" FROM workflow_node n LEFT JOIN capability c ON c.id = n.capability_id WHERE n.node_type = 'task' AND c.code IS NOT NULL AND n.workflow_id = ( SELECT workflow_id FROM workflow_node WHERE node_type = 'task' AND capability_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY workflow_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY n.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.node_key AS "nodeKey", cap.code AS "capabilityCode" FROM workflow_node n JOIN capability cap ON cap.id = n.capability_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.workflow_id = #{param2} AND n.node_type = 'task'

SELECT w.id AS "workflowId", w.name AS "name", w.graph->>'xml' AS "xml", n.node_key AS "nodeKey", cap.code AS "capabilityCode" FROM workflow w LEFT JOIN workflow_node n ON n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task' LEFT JOIN capability cap ON cap.id = n.capability_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{param1}
